This is the default configuration for Tiny Tapeout projects. It should fit most designs.
If you change it, please make sure you understand what you are doing. We are not responsible
if your project fails because of a bad configuration.
!!! DO NOT EDIT THIS FILE unless you know what you are doing !!!
If you get stuck with this config, please open an issue or get in touch via the discord.
Here are some of the variables you may want to change:
PL_TARGET_DENSITY_PCT - You can increase this if Global Placement fails with error GPL-0302.
Users have reported that values up to 80 worked well for them.
PESM: 40 instead of the template's 60. CMOS5L routes signals on Metal2-Metal4 only (a
single horizontal layer); at 60 % detailed routing needed 34 iterations and detoured
critical nets. See pnr/README.md.
CLOCK_PERIOD - Increase this in case you are getting setup time violations.
The value is in nanoseconds, so 20ns == 50MHz.
Hold slack margin - Increase them in case you are getting hold violations.
PESM: 0.15 / 0.10 instead of the template's 0.1 / 0.05, so that the fast corner keeps
positive hold slack after routing (it ends up close to the post-GRT margin).
PESM timing closure for the slow corner (1.08 V, 125 C). See pnr/README.md.
1. Wire RC for timing repair. The CMOS5L PDK ships an empty LAYERS_RC, so the resizer
would use LEF values (9.7e-5 pF/um, 0.39 ohm/um) while the routed design extracts at
1.7e-4 pF/um and 1.2 ohm/um. These are the SG13G2 values (kOhm/um, pF/um; same metals).
Placement-stage estimates use the average of these layers (Metal2/3 carry over 90 % of the wire).
2. Repair slew/cap and setup again on global-route parasitics. LibreLane marks these two
steps experimental (possible long run times). With both set to 0 the local replay still
closes, at +3.3 ns in the slow corner instead of +4.7 ns.
3. Ask the resizer for more than the 3 ns sign-off target: the estimate-to-signoff error
in the slow corner is about 1 ns. The resizer works on all three corners.
4. Slew headroom for the slow corner (library limit 2.5 ns).
RUN_LINTER, LINTER_INCLUDE_PDK_MODELS - Disabling the linter is not recommended!
If you need a custom clock configuration, read the following documentation first:
https://tinytapeout.com/faq/#how-can-i-map-an-additional-external-clock-to-one-of-the-gpios
Configuration docs: https://librelane.readthedocs.io/en/latest/reference/configuration.html

Save some time
Don't put clock buffers on the outputs
Reduce wasted space
Absolute die size
Clock
Don't generate power rings
MAGIC_DEF_LABELS may cause issues with LVS
